Usage: bm tool edit-note [OPTIONS] {identifier}                                
                                                                                
 Edit an existing markdown note using                                           
 append/prepend/find_replace/replace_section.                                   
                                                                                
 Examples:                                                                      
                                                                                
 bm tool edit-note my-note --operation append --content "new content"           
 bm tool edit-note my-note --operation find_replace --find-text "old" --content 
 "new"                                                                          
 bm tool edit-note my-note --operation replace_section --section "## Notes"     
 --content "updated"                                                            
 bm tool edit-note my-note --operation replace_section --section "## Notes"     
 --content "updated" --no-replace-subsections                                   
                                                                                
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    identifier      <str>  [required]                                       │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  --operation                                   <str>  Edit operation to    │
│                                                         apply                │
│                                                         [required]           │
│ *  --content                                     <str>  Content for the edit │
│                                                         operation            │
│                                                         [required]           │
│    --find-text                                   <str>  Text to find for     │
│                                                         find_replace         │
│                                                         operation            │
│    --section                                     <str>  Section heading for  │
│                                                         replace_section      │
│                                                         operation            │
│    --expected-replace…                           <int>  Expected replacement │
│                                                         count for            │
│                                                         find_replace         │
│                                                         operation            │
│                                                         [default: 1]         │
│    --replace-subsecti…    --no-replace-subse…           For replace_section, │
│                                                         replace nested       │
│                                                         subsections too; use │
│                                                         --no-replace-subsec… │
│                                                         to preserve them     │
│                                                         [default:            │
│                                                         replace-subsections] │
│    --project                                     <str>  The project to edit. │
│                                                         If not provided, the │
│                                                         default project will │
│                                                         be used.             │
│    --project-id                                  <str>  Project external_id  │
│                                                         (UUID). Takes        │
│                                                         precedence over      │
│                                                         --project; use to    │
│                                                         disambiguate         │
│                                                         same-named projects  │
│                                                         across cloud         │
│                                                         workspaces.          │
│    --local                                              Force local API      │
│                                                         routing (ignore      │
│                                                         cloud mode)          │
│    --cloud                                              Force cloud API      │
│                                                         routing              │
│    --help                                               Show this message    │
│                                                         and exit.            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
